provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: Every active potential monomial has at least two basic Casimir factors.
provenance.method: Adjoint sl2 branching and the nilcone-slice complete intersection; two exact expansion algorithms
provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal for the scalar Casimir graph presentation. Does not compute full Macdonald, establish physical filtration uniqueness, locate a jump or extend Schur validation.

provenance.variable_convention: z^2 = t = qT; degrees in the rational function are z degrees
